_comment: Corpus index coverage ratchet (DATA, not code). ADR-0541 Corpus Liveness Graph. A buck2 package that OWNS at least one YAML file is INDEXED iff it declares a corpus-yaml-facts extraction target, which makes that YAML a build-graph input whose facts are a build output. Two ceilings, both shrink-only: baseline_uncovered_packages is the in-graph debt (packages that could be indexed today and are not), and baseline_unpackaged_yaml_files is the NORTHSTAR debt (YAML files belonging to no buck2 package, which cannot be indexed at all until they are pulled INTO the build graph). The second ceiling is deliberately the larger number: indexing an artifact through a side channel would improve a coverage score while leaving it outside the graph, so the gate counts unpackaged files in the DENOMINATOR and never lets a side channel look like progress. The two min_expected_* floors are the anti-vacuity backstop: a walk that silently sees nothing reports zero uncovered files, which reads as PERFECT coverage, so a collapsed census fails the gate closed. ALL repo-specifics are DATA — another repo adopts this gate by repointing these five numbers.

measured._comment: Measured by the live gate at freeze time, recorded so a later reader can see whether the ratchet moved or the corpus did. yaml_files_total counts the walk's census, which skips dot-directories; a git ls-files census reports 8 more (.github/**) and is not the number the ceilings are frozen against. Re-anchored 2026-08-05 when infra/gitops + infra/talos packages pulled 15 YAML files into the graph (448→433). Re-anchored 2026-08-06 on PR #1584: audit/BUCK packages residual rehome YAML; only the 8 pre-existing unpackaged audit/observability SLO YAML leave the unpackaged set (433→425); oya census 4103→4042 after oya/audit-chain residual leave oya/. Re-anchored 2026-08-07 residual_single wave0 billing rehome: billing/BUCK packages residual YAML (unpackaged 425→413); oya census 4042→3992 after accounting/finops-portal/oya-billing leave oya/. Merged origin/dev PR #1611 orphan scaffold deletes (emr/healthcare/pharmacy/social/patient-monitoring): provisional oya census 3992→3799 pending re-measure after wave6.

product_contract.born_advisory: Born ADVISORY over today's debt and BLOCKING on regression. 18 YAML-owning packages declare no extraction target and 413 YAML files sit outside every buck2 package; both are reported as advisory findings and frozen as ceilings. A NEW uncovered package, or NEW YAML outside the build graph, exceeds its ceiling and fails closed.
product_contract.shrink_only: Both ceilings are lowered as extraction targets and service-root packages land. The gate emits a corpus_index_stale_ceiling advisory whenever a ceiling sits above the measured number, so slack cannot silently accumulate and absorb the next regression.
product_contract.pack_shaped: The Rust kernel hardcodes no oyatie path. Package census, file census, and both ceilings are DATA.
product_contract.anti_vacuity: min_expected_yaml_packages, min_expected_yaml_files and min_expected_unpackaged_yaml_files fail the gate closed when the walk collapses. Without them a broken walk reports zero uncovered packages, which is indistinguishable from full coverage. The first two guard the CENSUS; the third guards the ATTRIBUTION, and it is not redundant with them. Re-anchoring the census floor onto packaged+unpackaged (#1514) correctly stopped package adoption from tripping the guard, but that total is invariant under mis-attribution: if every file were wrongly assigned to some package, packaged rises by exactly what unpackaged loses, the package count is unchanged, and the total floor still holds while the unpackaged term — the one the northstar ratchet rides on — reads zero and looks like the debt being paid off. Only a floor on that term catches it.
product_contract.known_limitations: Source-derived extraction faces use the canonical BUCK AST parser but are not a Starlark evaluator, so configured Buck2 targets/uquery parity remains mandatory. Only the YAML artifact class is measured; markdown, JSON, TOML, and Cedar each need their own extractor and their own ceiling.

purpose: Make 'everything in the code graph and the build graph' a measured, shrink-only invariant instead of a slogan, by counting indexed vs total artifacts and letting the number move in only one direction.
